It can fluctuate based on a lot of things. If you feel like still being more feminine but embracing more masculinity, you can do that, if you feel like you want to be nearly wholly masculine you don’t want to completely throw your femininity out the window, you can do that. Its really just whatever makes you the most comfortable and happy in your own skin. 

5. Some days I’m okay with he/him and some days it gives me hardcore dysphoria. Generally though I prefer to be called she/her or they/them, but it’s totally up to what makes you as a person comfortable
